carrier_insertion.description: Bench preassembly: slide motor/plate from rear -Y into already fixed shoes before adding lock bridges, bolts and adjuster. This is an untested required assembly path, not included among the axial access declarations.

pending_checks: Common four new holes and their native wall/seat/bolt/nut/tool access.
All new/retained native parts, cord segments and clearances at D118/120/122; intermediate Y travel and motor rotation need their declared sampling/sweeps.
All 28 local seats at the three carriage displacements; slot banks must carry bridge clamps and lower rails.
Rear carrier insertion including full 32-part motor module, fixed lips and rail fasteners; adjuster/tab construction order.
Guide clearance, yaw/lift free play, hole tolerances, binding, wear, friction and clamp preload/strength.
Two-millimetre custom bridge material and bending strength, screw engagement and loosening; geometric seats alone do not prove locking capacity.

antirotation.type: lower three-sided hex pocket plus axial walls and removable roof

adjuster_spec.work_load_path: Tendons -> motor -> locked carriage shoes/clamps -> common plate. During adjustment only: carriage nut -> screw -> either captured head thrust face -> fixed post -> two base stacks -> common plate.
assembly_order: Make and inspect the carrier tab/pilots/taps before installing motor hardware.
Drop travelling nut from+Z, install lid and its two M2 countersunk screws.
With both guide shoes and common plate absent, lower carrier tab from+Z into the fixed-post stop window. This replaces the older rear-slide carrier sequence.
Install thrust washer and rotate lead screw through travelling nut; install front cap, rear keyed nuts and front M4 cap screws. No rear50mm socket is used.
While post/carrier are supported as a subassembly, insert the empty left/right shoes laterally from-X/+X. Their lower faces and lift lips surround the plate; verify the actual full subassembly paths.

Place the post/carrier/shoe subassembly onto the common plate before cords. Install shoe/post base stacks and separate carrier lock bridges. Handling/support during this order is not physically qualified.
Set each cord length separately at reference pose. Release carrier locks, approach desired common setting from one direction, then lock carrier and remeasure.
Refit any removed original covers/caps and verify actual cord routing and clamp/tool access; previous32 approach checks do not cover these operations.
limitations: Written source only until the parent explicitly generates and audits the saved BRep. No CAD run or fixture fit is claimed by this module.
Maximum supplier-size envelopes are not precision adjustment hardware. Measure chosen head, washer and nut and fit the custom capture gaps; no shim/selection approval is assumed.
No helical threads, actual runout, tip chamfer, preload, tensile capacity, galling, wear, friction or locking torque is modelled.
M2 lid holes require a finished engineering tapping drawing; the assembly major bore must not be used as the pilot drill.
Separate carriage locks carry operating loads. This screw is not an automatically regulated tension spring or force sensor.
Two rope rest lengths remain independent; common Y motion neither equalizes force nor proves tension retention.
Free washer/head/nut rotations, axial play and endpoint seats need declared supplemental checks. Nominal contact does not approve all tolerances.
Driver access, rear nut socket room, carrier/lid insertion and old motor/coupon/cover/cord assembly must be audited in stated stages.
The central motor horn retainer, whole-hand integration, physical preload and50/100ms tracking performance remain unresolved.
Detached one-axis fixture; accepted hand geometry and whole-hand assembly are unchanged.
Nominal supplier dimension envelopes, no helical thread or tolerance/strength approval.
Central horn retainer, actual pretension and joint angle sensing remain unresolved.
